authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India

description.en: PM Vishwakarma is a central sector scheme launched to provide end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools in 18 identified trades. The scheme offers recognition through the PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card, skill training (basic and advanced), a toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000, collateral-free credit support of up to Rs. 3 lakh at concessional interest rates, incentive for digital transactions, and marketing support. Registration is done through Common Service Centres (CSCs) or gram panchayats with verification at the district and state levels.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: All applicants for PM Vishwakarma registration
verifiedConditions.claim: The applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 identified trades: carpenter, boat maker, armourer, blacksmith, hammer and tool kit maker, locksmith, goldsmith, potter, sculptor/stone carver, cobbler/shoemaker, mason/bricklayer, basket/mat/broom maker, doll and toy maker (traditional), barber, garland maker, washerman, tailor, and fishing net maker.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: All applicants for PM Vishwakarma registration
verifiedConditions.claim: The applicant must be at least 18 years of age on the date of registration.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: All applicants for PM Vishwakarma registration
verifiedConditions.claim: The applicant and their family members should not be in government service (central or state). A family is defined as the applicant, their spouse, and unmarried children.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: All applicants for PM Vishwakarma registration
verifiedConditions.claim: The applicant or their family members should not have availed loans under similar central government credit-based self-employment schemes such as PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra in the past 5 years.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: All applicants for PM Vishwakarma registration
verifiedConditions.claim: Only one member per family is eligible for registration under the PM Vishwakarma scheme. A family is defined as the applicant, spouse, and unmarried children.

unverifiedEligibility: Some states may have additional verification requirements or prioritization criteria for PM Vishwakarma registration; state-level variations are not detailed here.
Artisans who have transitioned to semi-mechanized or mechanized production may have different eligibility considerations that are not fully specified.

requirements.claim: Aadhaar number is mandatory for PM Vishwakarma registration. Aadhaar-based eKYC verification is used for identity authentication during the registration process.
A valid mobile number is required for OTP verification during registration and for receiving scheme-related communications and updates.

A bank account in the name of the applicant is required for receiving scheme benefits including the toolkit incentive and credit support. The bank account details must be verified during registration.
Ration card or similar family identification document may be required for verifying the family composition and ensuring only one member per family is registered under the scheme.

Verification and recommendation from the Gram Panchayat (for rural areas) or Urban Local Body (for urban areas) is required to certify that the applicant is a traditional artisan or craftsperson engaged in the claimed trade.

processInformation.appliesTo: All applicants registering for PM Vishwakarma
processInformation.claim: Registration is done through the PM Vishwakarma portal (pmvishwakarma.gov.in) with assistance from Common Service Centres (CSCs), Gram Panchayats, or Urban Local Bodies. The applicant visits a CSC or local body, provides Aadhaar and personal details, selects the trade, and completes biometric/OTP verification. The Gram Panchayat or ULB head verifies and recommends the application.
doesNotEstablish: This record does not store any personal identity data or biometric information.
CSC-specific facilitation charges, if any, are not covered.

processInformation.appliesTo: Applications recommended by Gram Panchayat or ULB
processInformation.claim: After Gram Panchayat/ULB recommendation, the application is forwarded to the District Implementation Committee (DIC) for verification. The DIC verifies the applicant's trade, eligibility, and supporting documents. Approved applications proceed to certificate generation and benefit disbursal.
doesNotEstablish: This record does not define the DIC's internal verification procedures or timelines in detail.

processInformation.claim: Registered beneficiaries receive skill training in two phases: basic training (5-7 days with a stipend of Rs. 500 per day) and advanced training (15 days or more with a stipend of Rs. 500 per day). Training is provided through designated training centres to upgrade the skills of traditional artisans.
doesNotEstablish: This record does not list specific training centres or their locations.
Training curriculum and schedule may vary by trade and state.

processInformation.appliesTo: Registered PM Vishwakarma beneficiaries seeking credit
processInformation.claim: Beneficiaries are eligible for collateral-free credit: first tranche of up to Rs. 1 lakh (to be repaid in 18 months) and second tranche of up to Rs. 2 lakh (to be repaid in 30 months), at a concessional interest rate of 5% with the remaining interest being subsidized by the government. Credit is provided through scheduled commercial banks.
doesNotEstablish: This record does not define bank-specific lending procedures or credit assessment criteria.
Loan approval is subject to the lending bank's assessment.

output.claim: Upon successful registration and verification, the beneficiary receives the PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card, which provides recognition as a traditional artisan/craftsperson. The beneficiary becomes eligible for skill training (with stipend), toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000, collateral-free credit up to Rs. 3 lakh at 5% interest, incentive for digital transactions, and marketing support including quality certification and branding.

fees.applicability: PM Vishwakarma registration, certificate generation, and scheme benefits
fees.claim: There is no registration fee for the PM Vishwakarma scheme. All benefits including skill training, toolkit incentive, credit support, and marketing support are provided free of cost or at highly subsidized rates to eligible artisans and craftspeople.

processingTime.applicability: PM Vishwakarma registration including GP/ULB recommendation and district-level verification
processingTime.claim: The registration process involves multiple stages: initial registration at CSC/GP/ULB, verification by Gram Panchayat or ULB head, and approval by the District Implementation Committee. The complete process may take 15 to 45 days depending on the verification stages and local processing capacity.

limitations: This record covers PM Vishwakarma registration, eligibility, and scheme benefits at the central level only; state-specific implementation details, training centre lists, and processing timelines may vary.
Credit support under the scheme is subject to the lending bank's assessment and approval; registration does not guarantee loan disbursal.
The list of 18 trades is as per the scheme guidelines at the time of verification; any additions or modifications to the trade list are not automatically reflected.
No Aadhaar number, bank account details, or personal identity data is collected or stored by this content record.
Marketing support components (GeM onboarding, trade fairs, quality certification) and their availability depend on state-level implementation and are not detailed here.
